candidates.title: [3.10] gh-146581: Fix vulnerability in shutil.unpack_archive() for ZIP files on Windows (GH-146591) (GH-149071)
candidates.body:
gh-146581: Fix vulnerability in shutil.unpack_archive() for ZIP files on Windows (GH-146591)

Use ZipFile.extractall() to sanitize file names and extract files.

Files with invalid names (e.g. absolute paths) are now skipped.

Files containing ".." in the name are no longer skipped.
(cherry picked from commit 7ef7dd0a74f47facd1fadcbc77f8fb03beb5eb4d)

Co-authored-by: Serhiy Storchaka <storchaka@gmail.com>
(cherry picked from commit fc829e88753858c8ac669594bf0093f44948c0f4)

gh-75876: Use functools.wraps() in test.support test decorators (GH-155262)

bigmemtest(), bigaddrspacetest() and no_rerun() returned a wrapper named
"wrapper", so a decorator applied on top of them could not identify the test.

candidates.body:

auto_merge.commit_message:
On Windows, subprocess.Popen() with shell=True no longer overrides
wShowWindow of the startupinfo argument, so the console window of the
started program can be shown.

Co-authored-by: Serhiy Storchaka <storchaka@gmail.com>
